# Summary

What does this change do, and why?

# Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / chore

# Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass in `pgforge/`
- [ ] Code is `gofmt`-clean
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) if user-visible
- [ ] Updated `pgforge/changelog.go` if the change is a user-facing feature
- [ ] Tested on a throwaway server (not production)

# Notes for reviewers

Anything that needs extra attention, screenshots for UI changes, etc.
